ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Technical Lead to lead deployment and operations for OpenAI’s Silicon & Systems team. This person will become the Directly-Responsible Individual responsible for bringing OpenAI’s custom silicon and associated systems into data center environments, ensuring successful deployment, bring-up, validation, operational readiness, and ongoing reliability at scale.

This role sits at the intersection of silicon, systems, infrastructure, data center operations, and software. You will lead a team focused on taking new hardware platforms from lab validation into production data center deployment. You will be responsible for building the operational processes, technical workflows, tooling, and cross-functional alignment required to deploy and operate custom AI hardware reliably in OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is both a strong leader and a deeply technical operator. You should be comfortable staying close to the technical details of hardware bring-up, fleet deployment, debugging, system validation, data center integration, and production operations. This role requires strong execution, excellent cross-functional judgment, and the ability to drive clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead a team responsible for deployment and operations of OpenAI’s custom silicon and systems in data center environments

- Own the path from hardware bring-up and validation through production deployment, operational readiness, and sustained fleet support

- Partner closely with silicon, systems, software, infrastructure, networking, data center, supply chain, and external partner teams to ensure successful deployment at scale

- Define deployment processes, operational playbooks, technical readiness criteria, escalation paths, and reliability practices for new hardware platforms

- Drive cross-functional execution across lab bring-up, rack/system integration, data center deployment, fleet monitoring, debugging, and issue resolution

- Stay hands-on technically through architecture reviews, deployment planning, failure analysis, operational debugging, and critical system-level decision-making

- Identify gaps in tooling, observability, automation, validation coverage, and operational processes, and build plans to close them

- Establish clear metrics for deployment readiness, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational health

- Build a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, operational excellence, and high-velocity execution

- Ensure OpenAI’s custom hardware platforms can be deployed and operated reliably, repeatably, and safely at scale

- Be a contributor and technical driver for the architecture and design of future ML systems

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Enjoy mentoring and developing engineers while staying deeply engaged in technical execution

- Are excited by the challenge of bringing new custom hardware platforms into real-world production data center environments

- Can operate across silicon, systems, software, infrastructure, and data center operations

- Are comfortable leading through ambiguity, especially when the hardware, tooling, and operational model are still being built

- Have strong judgment around deployment sequencing, technical risk, operational readiness, and when to escalate

- Communicate clearly across technical and operational teams, and can align stakeholders through complex deployment and production issues

- Care deeply about building practical systems, tools, and processes that work reliably at scale

- Have a bias toward ownership and are comfortable jumping into urgent technical issues when needed

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of engineering experience in hardware systems, infrastructure, data center deployment, production operations, systems engineering, silicon bring-up, or related technical domains

- Strong technical depth in one or more of: hardware deployment, data center operations, rack-scale systems, silicon bring-up, systems validation, fleet operations, reliability engineering, infrastructure automation, or hardware/software integration

- Experience bringing complex hardware systems from development or validation into production environments

- Experience working closely with silicon, systems, software, infrastructure, networking, or data center teams

- Experience with deployment planning, operational readiness, incident response, debugging, and root-cause analysis for production systems

- Experience building tooling, automation, observability, or operational processes that improve deployment quality and fleet reliability

- Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead senior technical talent

- Ability to move fluidly between people leadership, technical strategy, and hands-on operational problem solving

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in high-urgency, cross-functional technical environments

- Experience working in fast-moving environments

jobs.description: Have you ever wondered how Amazon manages its own presence in the cloud? Amazon is one of AWS's largest customers, and here in the Amazon Cloud Management Foundations (ACMF) organization, we architect and build the services that govern how Amazonians access, organize, and operate their AWS accounts. We work with customers and peers from the entire range of Amazon's businesses to drive initiatives in AWS. Our team owns the governance layer for Amazon's cloud infrastructure. We define how thousands of AWS accounts are classified, how access policies are enforced, and how teams across Amazon operate within a consistent, secure framework. Our services underpin every Amazon business, from e-Commerce to Prime, Alexa, and Prime Video. We are building the next generation of enterprise account governance for Amazon. This means rethinking how accounts are described, how policies are applied, and how guardrails scale with Amazon's growth. If you want to shape the future of how one of the world's largest cloud environments is governed, you've found the right place. As a Technical Program Manager at ACMF, you will own the program strategy for enterprise account governance across Amazon. You'll define the vision for how governance policies, account classification, and access controls evolve to meet the needs of Amazon's builders. You will lead cross-organizational programs from concept to launch, working with engineering, product, and security teams to deliver capabilities that thousands of teams depend on. You will build alignment across senior leaders, translate ambiguity into structure, and drive programs that operate at Amazon's full scale. Key job responsibilities Define and drive the program strategy for enterprise account governance across Amazon, translating ambiguity into clear roadmaps that teams can execute against. Own cross-organizational programs end-to-end, from requirements through delivery, working with engineering, product, and security teams to ship governance capabilities that thousands of builders depend on. Build alignment across senior leaders and stakeholders on how account classification, access policies, and guardrails should evolve as Amazon scales. Identify gaps in how accounts are described, organized, and governed today. Propose and drive programs that close those gaps while keeping operational burden low for service owners and developers. Establish mechanisms for tracking program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use data to inform prioritization and communicate progress to leadership. Develop trusted partnerships with technical and non-technical teams across Amazon's businesses, ensuring governance programs reflect the needs of diverse builders operating at different risk profiles. Evaluate complex technical and business requirements, surface tradeoffs and risks early, and drive decisions that balance governance rigor with builder velocity. A day in the life This role is inherently cross-functional and requires a strong ability to think big and influence others as you will work closely with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and security. We are looking for a critical thinker who thrives on solving challenges in partnership with teams across Amazon. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience across cloud, AI/ML, retail, and more. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

DART(Detection And Response Team)는 쿠팡 전사로 발생하는 사이버 위협을 탐지하고 대응하여 사이버 위협으로부터 발생할 수 있는 피해를 최소화하는데 목표를 두고 있습니다.

이후 보안사고로 이어질 수 있는 심각도가 높은 이벤트는 상위 조직인 DART로 Escalation하여 심층분석이 이루어지도록 하고, 개선방안을 도출하여 동일한 위협이 재발생하지 않도록 조치를 하고 있습니다.

• CSOC대응 절차(Playbook)의 문서화 및 개선 업무의 메인 담당자

jobs.description: Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: - Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary. - Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement. - Maintain all records of care provided to AAs. - Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries. - Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports. - Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits. - Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained. - Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes. - Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials. - Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends. - Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols. - Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site. Additional Job Elements include: - Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach - Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts - Work in an environment where the noise level varies - Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments) - Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs) For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Scopely is seeking a Director, Legal Operations to join our Legal team. This role will lead the Legal Operations function and establish the strategy, operating model, technology roadmap, governance framework, and performance infrastructure for a global, high-growth Legal department. This role will be a hybrid position in our Culver City, CA hub.

The Director will directly manage the Sr. Manager, Legal Operations, who owns day-to-day Ironclad CLM operations, knowledge management infrastructure, and AI-enabled legal technology implementation. The Director will provide strategic direction, prioritize the team’s roadmap, manage resources and vendors, and remain accountable for the quality, adoption, and business impact of these programs.

This is a senior people-leadership and functional-building role for someone who can translate Legal leadership’s priorities into scalable systems, processes, and measurable outcomes. The right candidate will combine strategic judgment, operational discipline, technical fluency, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted partnerships across Legal and the broader business . as a strategic business partner, not just a support or systems-administration function. They will be comfortable operating in ambiguity, creating structure where none exists, and leading through influence in a fast-paced global gaming company.

What You Will Do

Legal Operations Strategy & Functional Leadership

• Partner directly with Legal leadership to define and execute a multi-year Legal Operations strategy aligned with Scopely’s business priorities and growth
• Translate Legal department priorities into an integrated roadmap covering technology, process improvement, data, knowledge management, automation, training, and organizational capability
• Establish annual and quarterly priorities, success metrics, resource plans, and sequencing recommendations for the Legal Operations team
• Advise Legal leadership on tradeoffs among business impact, risk, cost, speed, and available team capacity
• Develop the Legal Operations budget, oversee spend, build business cases for new investments, and manage vendor and renewal strategy
• Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and simplify Legal processes across Commercial, Corporate, Employment, Product Compliance, and other Legal functions
• Directly manage, coach, and develop the Sr. Manager, Legal Operations, who owns Ironclad CLM operations, knowledge management infrastructure, and AI implementation

Legal Technology Strategy & Governance

• Serve as the executive owner of Scopely’s Legal technology portfolio and establish a coherent architecture and investment strategy across CLM, knowledge management, matter management, e-billing, contract analytics, automation, and related tools
• Own the Legal technology roadmap, including technology selection, implementation sequencing, integration priorities, system rationalization, and long-term scalability
• Oversee Ironclad CLM as a critical Legal and business system, ensuring that the Sr. Manager has the direction, resources, governance framework, and stakeholder alignment necessary to operate the platform effectively
• Establish governance standards for workflow design, metadata, templates, permissions, approval logic, integrations, repository integrity, data retention, change management, and system access
• Review and approve significant platform changes, balancing user experience, business needs, control requirements, data integrity, and long-term maintainability
• Partner with IT, Information Security, Privacy, Procurement, Finance, and external vendors on architecture, security, integrations, implementation, support, and risk management
• Lead or oversee system migrations, data consolidation efforts, post-acquisition integrations, and other technology transformation initiatives

Knowledge Management, Automation & AI

• Establish the strategic vision and operating model for Legal knowledge management, including content architecture, taxonomy, ownership, curation, searchability, version control, and access governance
• Ensure that Legal’s institutional knowledge is captured, structured, maintained, and made accessible in ways that support self-service, consistency, and future AI applications
• Develop a portfolio of practical AI and automation use cases for Legal in partnership with Legal leadership, IT, and relevant business stakeholders
• Oversee the implementation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools, including chatbots, knowledge-based assistants, workflow automation, contract analytics, and other emerging technologies
• Direct the Sr. Manager’s hands-on execution of knowledge management and AI initiatives, including platform configuration, testing, content population, user feedback, optimization, and rollout
• Define success metrics for AI and automation initiatives, including adoption, response quality, time saved, reduction in repetitive inquiries, and measurable improvements to the Legal user experience
• Stay current on legal technology and AI developments and make informed recommendations regarding opportunities, risks, and investment priorities

Process Improvement & Business Partnership

• Serve as a strategic partner to Legal leadership, Procurement, Finance, Information Security, IT, People, Product, and other stakeholders to improve the end-to-end process of contracting and Legal support experience
• Establish scalable intake, triage, and routing models that direct work to the appropriate Legal or business resource and minimize unnecessary attorney involvement
• Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify recurring friction, diagnose root causes, and implement structural solutions rather than one-off fixes
• Support Legal leadership to define and adopt practical playbooks, self-service resources, approval frameworks, and standardized workflows

Data, Analytics & Performance Management

• Act as a strategic partner with Commercial Legal to design and monitor metrics such as contracting cycle times, intake volumes, routing accuracy, self-service rates, workflow adoption, support trends, system reliability, automation impact, and stakeholder satisfaction
• Establish a Legal Operations performance framework that measures the efficiency, quality, adoption, capacity, and business impact of Legal services and systems
• Create executive-ready dashboards and reporting for Legal leadership, highlighting trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions
• Use data to support capacity planning, prioritization, investment decisions, vendor management, and continuous improvement

What We’re Looking For

• 7-10+ years of experience in Legal Operations, legal technology, business operations, process transformation, consulting, or a related field, with clear progression in scope, responsibility, and organizational leadership
• Demonstrated experience leading or building a Legal Operations function within a high-growth technology, gaming, entertainment, digital media, or similarly complex global company
• At least 3–5 years of experience managing, coaching, and developing professionals, including experience setting priorities, delegating ownership, giving feedback, and building team capability
• Experience establishing a Legal Operations strategy, operating model, roadmap, budget, governance framework, and performance-measurement program
• Significant experience with enterprise CLM programs, including Ironclad or a comparable platform. Direct Ironclad administration experience is strongly preferred; the candidate must have sufficient technical depth to evaluate platform architecture, workflow design, data governance, integrations, controls, and adoption
• Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, negotiate with vendors, assess technology investments, and measure realized value
• Experience overseeing legal technology portfolios beyond CLM, such as knowledge management, e-billing, matter management, contract analytics, automation, compliance, or AI-enabled tools
• Proven ability to build or mature a knowledge management function and translate institutional knowledge into structured, searchable, reusable content
• Experience evaluating, implementing, governing, or scaling AI and automation tools in a professional-services, legal, technology, or corporate environment
• Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, and design solutions that scale
• Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior Legal and business leaders and translate technical or operational issues into clear business decisions
• Strong project and change-management skills, including the ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple teams with competing priorities
• A highly collaborative, practical, and service-oriented leadership style, with the judgment to balance user experience, business enablement, risk management, and operational discipline
• Comfort operating with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and the ability to create clarity, structure, and momentum amid ambiguity

Nice to Have

• Experience leading Legal Operations in a gaming, interactive entertainment, digital media, or consumer technology company
• Direct experience with Ironclad, contract analytics, legal knowledge platforms, or similar tools
• Experience with post-acquisition Legal technology integrations, data migrations, or operating-model integration
• Experience managing outside counsel, legal vendors, e-billing, matter management, or Legal department spend
• Experience developing responsible-use standards or governance frameworks for AI in a Legal or regulated environment
• Experience partnering with geographically distributed teams and supporting global Legal operations
• A sense of humor and a passion for mobile gaming

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the Director will have established a clear Legal Operations strategy and roadmap; created a well-functioning operating model for the Legal Operations team; enabled the Sr. Manager to own day-to-day CLM, knowledge management, and AI execution; implemented a consistent performance-reporting framework; strengthened governance across Legal technology; and delivered measurable improvements in self-service, workflow adoption, contracting efficiency, and Legal team capacity.

Location: This role is based at our Burlington, MA HQ working in a hybrid capacity( 3 days from the office and 2 days remote)

This role is specific to the current Coffee Operating Unit of KDP. Following the recent, successful acquisition of JDE Peet’s in April 2026, the Coffee Operating Unit will become its own independent publicly traded company. For more information on this, please visit keurigdrpepper.com

We are seeking a highly curious, analytical and social-first individual to join our North America Coffee Marketing organization as our Social Intelligence & Operations Manager. This individual will report to the Director, Social & Communications.

Social moves fast. We’re looking for someone who can help us understand not just what’s happening, but why it matters and what we should do about it.

This role will sit at the intersection of social, culture, consumers and data, elevating our approach to social listening, intelligence, analytics, technology and governance. You’ll turn millions of conversations and signals into actionable insights our brands can use, helping us to understand what consumers are saying, how culture is shifting, where our brands stand, what competitors are doing and where the next opportunity may be.

As a key member of the Connections + Creativity team, you’ll support iconic brands including Keurig®, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters® and The Original Donut Shop®, using social intelligence to inform everything from content and creative to community, campaigns and broader marketing decisions.

The ideal candidate is equal parts analytical thinker, cultural observer and strategic storyteller, with a track record of building successful social intelligence programs in-house or at an agency. You can dig into the data, but you don’t stop at the dashboard. You’re curious enough to ask why, strategic enough to determine so what, and confident enough to recommend now what. Most importantly, you’re passionate about social and culture and energized by the opportunity to turn insights into action and help our brands move at the speed of social.

What you will do:

Turn Social Signals Into Strategy

• Help drive our approach to social, with a specific focus on actionable recommendations across messaging, channels, influencers, and content using social intelligence tools and technology.

• Elevate our social intelligence program by working with teams to craft relevant, timely insights by understanding online behaviors of key audiences. This includes identification of cultural insights and connections to campaign performance.

• Partner closely with the Marketing Analytics team to infuse social data sets within marketing measurement models to drive business performance.

• Help shape our approach to social by translating social intelligence into clear, actionable recommendations across content, messaging, channels, creators and community.

• Elevate our social intelligence program by uncovering audience behaviors, cultural shifts, emerging conversations and whitespace opportunities that can inform brand and business decisions.

• Connect social and cultural insights to campaign and content performance to help teams understand not just what performed, but why.

• Partner closely with Marketing Analytics to connect social data with broader measurement approaches and build a more complete picture of brand and business performance.

Find the Story Behind the Data

• Find the story behind the data, turning complex social signals - from conversation drivers and sentiment to audience behaviors and influential voices - into clear insights and recommendations marketers and senior leaders can act on.

• Connect social intelligence to content, creative, community, media and audience strategy, helping teams understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what we should do next.

• Keep a pulse on competitors, category conversations, culture and best-in-class brands to understand where our brands are winning, what’s stopping the scroll and where untapped opportunities exist.

• Evolve how we measure the impact of social, from always-on content and planned campaigns to reactive moments and proactive cultural opportunities, connecting social performance to broader marketing and business objectives.

• Partner with teams across the organization to turn business questions into smart social intelligence approaches, bringing the right data, tools and perspective to uncover answers and inform decisions.

Build the Engine Behind the Work

• Help ensure our social intelligence capabilities, tools and processes allow our teams to move quickly and make smarter decisions.

• Conduct regular audits of tools and emerging partner capabilities to ensure our technology stack continues to meet evolving business needs.

• Oversee the continued enhancement of our social technology ecosystem and guide technology partners toward solutions fit for our Marketing organization.

• Help establish social governance, measurement frameworks and ways of working that enable teams across the organization to use social intelligence effectively and consistently.

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes social but thinks beyond the feed. You’re endlessly curious about people, culture and why conversations take off. You love finding the story hidden in the data and, more importantly, helping teams understand what to do with it.

You’re comfortable moving between dashboards and creative conversations, digging into a cultural moment one minute and presenting a recommendation to senior leadership the next. You thrive in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment and are excited by the opportunity to help build what best-in-class social intelligence looks like for our Coffee brands.

• Highly collaborative; excels at working cross-functionally to drive results

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

지난 2021년부터 크래프톤은 우리가 가진 게임 제작역량을 새롭게 확장할 수 있는 영역이자 새로운 도전을 지속할 분야로 딥러닝을 제시하고 해당 분야 연구에 집중하고 있으며, 본격화를 위하여 핵심 인재 영입 등 적극적인 투자를 진행하고 있습니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]

크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 사내외 여러 분야와 협업 하여 다양한 문제에 대한 AI 솔루션을 제공하며, 자체 딥러닝 기술 연구를 통해 우리만의 서비스를 개발합니다. 그 방향성은 크게 두가지입니다.

• 게임 제작에 도움이 될 수 있는 딥러닝 기술 개발을 통한 게임 제작 효율성 및 보편성 증대
• 유저와 함께 게임 플레이를 할 수 있는 Multi-modal LLM 기반 Foundation Model 개발

[Foundation Model R&D]

Foundation Model Research 팀은 AI Research 본부의 비전을 바탕으로 MLLM 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여, 새로운 플레이 경험을 만드는 데 기여합니다.

AI Research 본부 인원들은 다양한 프로젝트를 통하여 여러 분야의 팀원들과 교류하고 협업하며 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시할 수 있습니다. 나이 및 직급에 관계없이 자유롭게 의견을 개진하는 분위기가 장려됩니다. 다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 통·번역 등 언어적 장벽을 해소할 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.
